title: Co-Regulation Basics

definition.title: What Does Co-Regulation Mean?
definition.content: Co-regulation is the process through which a calm, emotionally available adult helps a child manage emotions, stress, behaviour and reactions. A child learns self-regulation by first experiencing co-regulation with trusted caregivers.

learningObjectives: Define co-regulation and why it matters
Understand how children learn emotional regulation
Build emotionally safe responses during stress

content: Children are not born with emotional regulation skills.
The adult nervous system influences the child's nervous system.
Safety and connection create learning opportunities.
Calm adults help children regain emotional balance.
Big emotional reactions are signs of unmet needs.
Children often communicate distress through behaviour.
